A-RIDE: Create a force, energy and modal ledger spanning motion ratio, wheel rate, corner spring geometry, modal kinetic-energy fractions, road transmissibility, damper dissipation and load transfer. A-TELEMETRY: Retain fixture identifiers and hashes, sequence/timestamps, exact CAN identifier bytes, BLE framing and decoded engineering values for a small replay excerpt.
